name: com.arcanumfleet/mcp
description: 16 live pay-per-request Solana, Base & Web tools over x402 v2 (0.001-0.01 USDC, no API keys).

tools.name: arcanum_pulse
tools.description: Use this first for a broad snapshot of live sanitized Solana momentum and audit signals across the fleet. Does not require a mint address. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_audit
tools.description: Use this when you have a specific Solana SPL mint address and need a full rug-check and safety verdict. For pool depth only, use arcanum_liquidity_check; for holder distribution, use arcanum_smart_money. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402.

mint.description: Base58 Solana SPL token mint address

tools.name: arcanum_engrams
tools.description: Use this to retrieve the fleet's distilled order-flow, risk, and execution heuristics evolved from live trades and community signals. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_consensus_vote
tools.description: Use this when you want a final BUY or SKIP trade decision with confidence score from the 10-node Consensus Admiral for a specific Solana mint. Costs 0.01 USDC via x402.

mint.description: Base58 Solana SPL token mint address

tools.name: arcanum_liquidity_check
tools.description: Use this before swapping to check real-time DexScreener USD pool depth, 24h volume, price, and swap_ready (>= $15k liquidity) for a Solana mint. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402.

mint.description: Base58 Solana SPL token mint address

tools.name: arcanum_smart_money
tools.description: Use this to inspect top-10 holder concentration, insider network count, and mint/freeze authority revocation for a Solana mint via RugCheck. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402.

mint.description: Base58 Solana SPL token mint address

tools.name: arcanum_social_sentiment
tools.description: Use this to read the latest sanitized narrative and engineering insights from Moltbook and Farcaster (solana, base, ai-agents channels). Costs 0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_jupiter_quote
tools.description: Use this to fetch a live Jupiter swap quote, expected output amount, price impact percentage, and route hop count between two Solana SPL mints. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402.

input_mint.description: Input SPL mint address (defaults to wrapped SOL)

tools.name: arcanum_trending_mints
tools.description: Use this to discover the top 10 trending Solana token mints by DexScreener boost and momentum activity. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_tx_simulate
tools.description: Use this before signing a Solana transaction to simulate it via RPC and check for execution errors, compute units, and authority-change risks. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_code_audit
tools.description: Use this to run a fast, 0-API-key security review on a code or smart-contract snippet (flags reentrancy, authority leaks, and logic bugs). Costs 0.001 USDC via x402.

code.description: Source code or smart-contract snippet to audit

tools.name: arcanum_wallet_profile
tools.description: Use this to inspect any Solana wallet's live SOL balance, top SPL token holdings, recent tx activity, and whale/trader tier — 0 API keys. Costs 0.003 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_web_extract
tools.description: Use this to fetch any public HTTP/HTTPS URL and extract clean LLM-ready text, page title, and meta description without HTML boilerplate — 0 API keys. Costs 0.001 USDC via x402.

url.description: Public https:// or http:// URL to extract

tools.name: arcanum_base_wallet_profile
tools.description: Use this to inspect any Base (eip155:8453) 0x wallet's live ETH balance, USDC balance, tx count, EOA vs contract status, and whale/active tier — 0 API keys. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_domain_enrich
tools.description: Use this to enrich any public domain with DNS A records, TLS/SSL cert issuer & expiry, HTTP server stack, and robots.txt/llms.txt agent readiness — 0 API keys. Costs 0.001 USDC via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_token_price
tools.description: Use this to fetch live USD price, 24h % change, 24h volume, and liquidity for any token symbol or contract address across Solana, Base, and Ethereum — 0 API keys. Costs 0.001 USDC via x402.

query.description: Token symbol (e.g. SOL, ETH, USDC) or contract/mint address

tools.name: arcanum_xrpl_wallet_profile
tools.description: Use this to inspect any XRPL (r...) wallet's live XRP balance, trustlines/RLUSD holdings, account sequence (tx activity), and whale/active tier — 0 API keys. Costs 0.002 USDC or XRP via x402.

tools.name: arcanum_perp_funding
tools.description: Use this to fetch live perpetual futures funding rates (1h + annualized APR %), mark price, open interest, and 24h volume from Hyperliquid for any symbol (e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP) or top 10 markets — 0 API keys. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402.

symbol.description: Optional perp symbol (e.g. SOL, BTC, ETH, XRP). Omit for top 10 by open interest.

tools.name: arcanum_base_dex_quote
tools.description: Use this to check live Base (eip155:8453) DEX pools (Aerodrome, Uniswap, BaseSwap) for any Base token symbol or 0x contract address — returns price, liquidity depth, 24h volume, and swap readiness — 0 API keys. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402.

token.description: Base token symbol (e.g. AERO, BRETT, VIRTUAL, WETH) or 0x contract address

tools.name: arcanum_token_radar
tools.description: Use this to rank high-implied-FDV tokenless (pre-token) DeFi protocols via live DeFiLlama TVL peer-multiples & 7d momentum — ideal for airdrop hunting & research across Solana, Base, Avalanche, or all chains — 0 API keys. Costs 0.005 USDC via x402.

chain.description: Optional chain filter (e.g. Solana, Base, Avalanche, Arbitrum). Omit for all chains.
